ksun.name: KernelSU Next
ksun.description: An advanced kernel-based root solution for Android

susfs.name: SuSFS
susfs.description: An addon root hiding kernel patches and userspace module for KernelSU

rtw88.name: Realtek WLAN
rtw88.description: CONFIG_WLAN_VENDOR_REALTEK, plus the out-of-tree rtw88 driver built as a module

ath.name: Atheros WLAN
ath.description: ATH9K, ATH9K_HTC and ATH10K (incl. USB) built as modules

bluetooth.name: Bluetooth
bluetooth.description: Support for common USB-based Bluetooth dongles (Broadcom, Realtek, Generic) and virtual HCI devices

sdr.name: SDR (Software Defined Radio)
sdr.description: Driver support for Airspy and HackRF hardware

can.name: CAN Bus
can.description: Broad support covering generic CAN networking, virtual CAN (vcan), Bosch internal IP (C_CAN, D_CAN, M_CAN), SPI-based controllers (MCP251X), and multiple USB-to-CAN hardware adapters

can_slcan.name: CAN SLCAN
can_slcan.description: Serial-line CAN driver, built as a module

mac80211_extras.name: mac80211 extras
mac80211_extras.description: LED triggers and Minstrel rate control for mac80211-based drivers

bbg.name: Baseband-guard
bbg.description: A lightweight LSM (Linux Security Module) for the Android kernel, designed to block unauthorized writes to critical partitions/device nodes at the system level.

lru_gen.name: Multi-Gen LRU
lru_gen.description: A high performance LRU implementation to overcommit memory

usb_serial.name: USB Serial
usb_serial.description: Support for debugging and interacting with serial-to-USB chips commonly found on microcontrollers and development boards (CH341, FTDI, PL2303)

ds.name: Droidspaces
ds.description: Droidspaces is a lightweight, portable Linux containerization tool that lets you run full Linux environments on top of Android
